Field of Nine - Digital Edition 2001.name: Field of Nine: Digital Edition 2001
Field of Nine - Digital Edition 2001.summary: Field of Nine: Digital Edition 2001 is a Sports game, published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 2001.

Gunstar Super Heroes.name: Gunstar Super Heroes
Gunstar Super Heroes.summary: Blue and Red, the lead characters in Gunstar Super Heroes, must once again keep a stone of great power from falling into the hands of an evil empire intent on resurrecting the God of Ruin. Blue and Red take on the same adventure using different paths, effectively making for two unique play-through experiences. Players will tackle six wildly inventive levels and take on gigantic bosses that fill the entire Game Boy Advance screen.

Hitsuji no Kimochi..name: Sheep
Hitsuji no Kimochi..summary:
Sheep takes puzzle game elements and blends them into a game that's tailor made for Game Boy Advance.
Your task? Guide these hapless creatures back to the truck. Sounds easy huh? It's not when your sheep keep going in the opposite direction!

Oshare Princess 2 + Doubutsu Kyaranabi U.name: Oshare Princess 2 + Doubutsu Kyaranabi Uranai
Oshare Princess 2 + Doubutsu Kyaranabi U.summary: Oshare Princess 2 + Doubutsu Kyaranabi Uranai is a Miscellaneous game, published by Culture Brain, which was released in Japan in 2002.

Ozzy & Drix.name: Ozzy & Drix
Ozzy & Drix.summary: A 2D platformer with 3D elements, Ozzy & Drix is based on the hit cartoon series from the Kids' WB! which in turn is based on the movie Osmosis Jones. Join the gross-out adventures of a white blood cell "cop," Ozzy, and his over-the-counter cold pill sidekick, Drix. Fans of the hit series will now be part of the action on Game Boy Advance. Whiz down a blood cell highway in the "Cel Camino," provide protection from the dreaded "Phlegm-alanche," face off against nemesis Spryman and Gluteus and more as Ozzy & Drix live and play in their world inside teenage boy Hector Cruz.

Rockman & Forte.name: Mega Man & Bass
Rockman & Forte.summary: Mega Man & Bass is an entry in the classic Mega Man series, with option for controlling either Mega Man or Bass, due to Dr. Wily and Dr. Light making a truce to fight against King. The game was originally released only in Japan, but a later Game Boy Advance port had an international release.

Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters International 2.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! 7 Trials to Glory: World Championship Tournament 2005
Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters International 2.summary: It is a game in the series of Yu-Gi-Oh video games made by Konami for the Nintendo Game Boy Advance portable video game system. The game is initially an RPG with strategy mixed in.
